syntactic_simplification: Mice are important in neuroscience research. They provide a flexible model for scientists. Scientists can control and study these mice to learn about the brain. Researchers have often used male mice in experiments. They prefer male mice because female mice experience a hormone cycle. This hormone cycle can cause changes in behavior. These changes might affect the results of experiments.
lexical_simplification: Mice are important in brain research. They provide a flexible way for scientists to work. Scientists can control and study these mice to learn about how the brain works. Researchers often use male mice in experiments. They choose male mice because female mice have a hormone cycle. This hormone cycle can cause changes in behavior. These changes might affect the results of the experiments.
paraphrase_or_explanation:
Mice are very important in research about the brain. They are a helpful option for scientists because they can easily control and study how mice behave and think. This helps researchers understand how the brain functions. 

In many studies, researchers often choose to work with male mice. They prefer using male mice because female mice go through hormonal changes each month. These hormonal changes can lead to different behaviors. If a female mouse acts differently because of these changes, it could make the results of the research less accurate or confusing.
prompt_used: You simplify complex texts by rewriting them in Plain English. Use clear, descriptive and explanatory language. It can contain more sentences than the original if it makes it easier to understand.
source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text:
Mice are very important in brain research. They are a helpful option for scientists because they can easily control and study how mice behave and think. This helps researchers understand how the brain functions.

In many studies, researchers often choose to work with male mice. They prefer using male mice because female mice go through hormonal changes each month. These changes can lead to different behaviors. If a female mouse acts differently because of these changes, it could make the research results less accurate or confusing.
